gloss: to exchange conversation; to have a conversation

definitions.gloss: to exchange conversation; to have a conversation; to converse
definitions.explanation: To engage in back-and-forth conversation with someone. Slightly more formal or literary than simply {話|はな}す, emphasizing the mutual, reciprocal nature of the exchange.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}の{人|ひと}と{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わした。
examples.english: I had a conversation with the person next to me.

examples.japanese: {久|ひさ}しぶりに{友人|ゆうじん}と{楽|たの}しい{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わした。
examples.english: I enjoyed a pleasant conversation with my friend after a long time.

examples.japanese: {初対面|しょたいめん}でも{自然|しぜん}に{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わせるようになりたい。
examples.english: I want to become able to naturally converse even with people I'm meeting for the first time.

notes:
A set expression combining {会話|かいわ} ('conversation') with the verb {交|か}わす ('to exchange'). The verb {交|か}わす adds a nuance of mutual, reciprocal exchange not present in simple {話|はな}す.

USAGE:
- More literary and descriptive than casual {話|はな}す or しゃべる
- Often used in narrative and written contexts to describe social interactions
- The same verb {交|か}わす appears in similar reciprocal expressions: {言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす ('to exchange words'), {挨拶|あいさつ}を{交|か}わす ('to exchange greetings')

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短|みじか}い{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わす: to have a brief conversation
- {楽|たの}しい{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わす: to have an enjoyable conversation
- {英語|えいご}で{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わす: to converse in English
- {目|め}で{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わす: to communicate through eye contact

RELATED WORDS:
- {言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす: to exchange words — more general, can be brief
- {挨拶|あいさつ}を{交|か}わす: to exchange greetings — specifically about greetings
- {話|はなし}をする: to have a talk — more casual and everyday
